name: 三色拼接雪裤
description:
粉色、奶黄色、浅蓝色三色拼接的雪裤，马卡龙配色很减龄，侧边有工装口袋。版型宽松好活动，配卫衣、外套都好看。单板、双板都适合。

## 面料与科技
- 3 层复合技术面料，全身接缝压胶，不渗水
- 防水指数 15000mm
- 透湿量 10000 g/m²，运动出汗也不闷

## 设计细节
- 粉、黄、蓝三色拼接
- 裤脚内置防雪裙，带防滑硅胶条，雪不容易进鞋
- 工装口袋和侧袋，小东西放得稳
- 宽松版型，动作不受限
- 可冷水轻柔机洗（30℃ 以下），不可漂白、熨烫，不用柔顺剂，阴凉处晾干
descriptionEn:
Pastel pink, cream and baby-blue color-blocked snow pants with cargo pockets on the side — playful and fresh. Relaxed fit that moves with you and pairs easily with hoodies and jackets. Great for snowboarding or skiing.

## Fabric & Tech
- 3-layer composite technical fabric with fully taped seams
- Waterproof rating 15,000 mm
- Breathability 10,000 g/m² so you stay dry during big runs

## Design Details
- Pink, cream and blue color-blocking
- Built-in leg gaiters with silicone grip strips keep snow out of your boots
- Cargo and side pockets for small essentials
- Relaxed fit for full freedom of movement
- Gentle cold machine wash (max 30°C); no bleach, ironing or fabric softener; hang dry in the shade
